item.title: Queen's Men's Basketball falls to Toronto Varsity Blues in overtime in Round 1 of OUA Playoffs
item.description: Queen's Men's Basketball fell to the Toronto Varsity Blues, 99-96 in overtime in Round 1 of the OUA Playoffs Wednesday night at the Athletics and Recreation Centre (ARC).

item.title: OUA Playoff time for Queen's Gaels
item.description: It's OUA postseason time and the Queen's Gaels are playoff ready!

item.title: 6–2 Victory Puts Queen’s Gaels in Driver’s Seat Against McGill
item.description: Queen's Men's Hockey launched their OUA playoff run on the road in Montreal, opening a best-of-three first-round series against the McGill Redbirds in a high-stakes postseason matchup.

item.title: Carving Their Stories: Black voices in hockey at Queen's
item.description: Members of Queen's Men's and Women's Hockey shared their experiences as Black hockey players.

item.title: Queen's students and alumni at Milano Cortina 2026 Olympics
item.description: Several current Queen's University students and alumni are competing at the 2026 Milano-Cortina Olympics this month.

item.title: 2026 season ticket packages for defending Yates Cup champion Queen’s Football on sale NOW
item.description: Queen's Football is defending the Yates Cup in 2026; make sure you're along for the ride!

item.title: Queen's Gaels mourn the passing of Football Champion and Coach Bob Howes
item.description: Queen's Athletics & Recreation is saddened to learn of the passing of Bob Howes, a distinguished Queen's alumnus, championship coach, and one of the most accomplished football student-athletes ever to wear the Tricolour.

item.title: Queen's Women's Volleyball take down Gryphons in three sets to advance to OUA semifinals
item.description: Queen's Women's Volleyball are heading to the OUA semifinals after a big 3-0 (25-11, 25-17, 25-14) win over the Guelph Gryphons in their quarterfinals matchup Friday night at the Athletics and Recreation Centre (ARC).

item.title: Queen's Men's Volleyball tops York Lions in straight sets to advance to OUA semifinals
item.description: Queen's Men's Volleyball topped the visiting York Lions in straight sets, 3-0 (25-21, 26-24, 25-23) Friday night in their OUA quarterfinals matchup at the Athletics and Recreation Centre (ARC). With the victory, the Gaels, who entered the OUA Playoffs as the No. 3 seed, advanced to the semifinals.

item.title: Queen’s Upset #3 Seed McGill in 2–1 OT Win to Complete Series Sweep.
item.description: The Queen's Men's Hockey team are moving on after completing a statement-making first-round sweep of the McGill Redbirds with a thrilling 2–1 overtime victory on Friday night at the Memorial Centre – upsetting the #3 seed in the process.
